info.name: Petpooja Online Ordering Menu Stores API
Turn a store's online ordering on or off (availability).

items.docs: Toggles a restaurant/store's online ordering availability and optionally sets a turn_on_time after which ordering resumes. The exact endpoint path and request schema are referenced in Petpooja integration material but are not fully published; this operation documents the known turn_on_time behavior. Treat the path and schema as unreconciled.
